## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b11a73470838bb8ba5b72e68f27604ebf3eb774f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md + none

Inputs read: card #31112 (body and all 27 comments), this PR's body, file list and net diff against `main` (merge-base `e0a78783`; `main` at `e1146e80` has not touched `skills/objectstack-data/**`, `skills/objectstack-upgrade/**`, `check-skill-links.mjs` or `check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` since), and the 44 check-runs on this head. The rest of the diff is one changeset file: the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`, read here for ② only.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set: unchanged — right.** No schema, validator, gate, script or example block is in the diff. No fenced block is added, removed, marked or unmarked, so `check:skill-examples` compiles the same set.
- **Public surface: two published SKILL.md files, navigation only — right.** Eight pointer lines and five orphaned `---` lines go; four index entries (data) and three in-place entries (upgrade) come in. No rule sentence is added, cut or reworded. Net: data +4 −18, upgrade +3 −5.
- **Link surface: five new fragments, all resolve — right.** Read against the target headings at this head and on `main`: `#quick-start-template` and `#metadata-protection-protection` in `references/examples-objects.md` (L51, L136); `#23-a-worked-r1--the-retired-field-mapping-transform`, `#34-the-report--the-human-half` and `#the-v17-canonical-shapes-compiled` in `references/examples-upgrade.md` (L3, L37, L86). The two file-top links (`references/seeds.md`, `references/lint-rules.md`) target single-section files whose first line is the named heading. No inbound link pointed at a stub position: the only other link into these reference files is data SKILL.md L104 (`#field-groups-mvp`), untouched.
- **Token ratchet: both rows shrink, no ceiling moved — right.** The script (`:153`) makes lowering a ceiling optional, so leaving 6665 and 6188 is allowed.
- **Gate verdicts:** all 44 check-runs on this head are completed; 28 success, 16 skipped, none failed or pending. `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Check Changeset`, `PR-body guards` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are among the green ones.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/31112-data-upgrade-moved-verbatim-stubs.md` declares `'@objectstack/skills': patch`. That matches what the diff publishes (prose navigation in two skill files of that package, `packages/skills/package.json`) and the card's Acceptance line. Its prose matches the tree: eight stubs, four index entries, one deletion, three in-place entries.

Clause-②: no — correct. Nothing a consumer could author or parse is narrowed or widened. `Metadata-protocol: none` — correct. The changeset and the PR body carry the same two lines.

### ③ Boundary flags

No `os-dev-report` for slice s7 is on the card, so there is no `open_questions` list. The flags below are read off the claim (6766041836) and the PR body.

- **Claim premise undercounts data ("each file carries 3").** Answered by the tree: data had five stubs on `main` (two spelled lowercase "moved verbatim", L459 and L463), as the card body counted. All five are handled. No residual "→ Moved verbatim" line is left in either file.
- **File surface "the stubs and their `---` runs only" versus four new lines in § Quick Reference.** Answered: within the surface. The card's item 2 orders each stub replaced "with the one-line section index entry it stands for, or delete"; the index is where data's entries belong, and both files are the claimed ones.
- **Lifecycle Hooks stub deleted with no replacement line ("seat ruling: no tail added").** Answered in ④: the surviving home holds. The thread ruling itself is not among my inputs; the tree is judged without it.
- **Ratchet-script row comments still say "one pointer line each" (`check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs:601`, `:793`).** Answered: outside the diff and the claimed surface; they are dated history and still read true of the new entries. Not reviewed.
- **`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` not measured locally.** Answered by CI: `Lint & Repo Gates` and the `Build Core` chain are green on this head.
- **Ceilings not lowered.** Answered in ①.

Nothing to escalate.

### ④ Design judgment

**skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md — holds.**

Each cut line against its surviving home:

| Cut (main) | Surviving home at this head | Verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| L239 Quick-Start Template stub | index L49 → `examples-objects.md` L51 | holds; fragment is new and correct |
| L367 Lifecycle Hooks stub | index L45 (unchanged) → `references/data-hooks.md` | holds, see below |
| L455 Metadata Protection stub | index L50 → `examples-objects.md` L136 | holds |
| L459 Seed Data & Fixtures stub | index L51 → `references/seeds.md` | holds |
| L463 Linting & Generation Quality stub | index L52 → `references/lint-rules.md` | holds |
| four `---` lines | none needed | holds; every remaining section still has exactly one separator before it (L241, L367, L451) |

Lifecycle Hooks: the stub pointed at `examples-objects.md` § Lifecycle Hooks (L112, an h3 inside § Quick-Start Template). That section is one `defineHook` example with a `body` plus a hand-off to `data-hooks.md`. Nothing is lost: the section is still in the file and is reached through the new Quick-Start entry, and `data-hooks.md` teaches the same shape in full (§ Hook Definition Schema L74–100, § Sandboxed Hook Bodies L308, § Common Patterns L737). The existing index entry is the right home.

Each new sentence against the code and text it cites on `main`:

- "one complete object: fields, `sharingModel`, `enable`, validations" — true of the `support_case` block (L54–106), which is marked for `check:skill-examples` and compiles in CI.
- "the `protection` block that locks shipped metadata against edits and deletes" — true: `packages/spec/src/shared/protection.zod.ts` carries the `none` / `no-overlay` / `no-delete` / `full` lock levels with that edit/delete table, and the target section opens with the same sentence.
- "`defineSeed()`, import modes, `externalId`, relationship references, CEL values" — true: `defineSeed` is exported from `packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts:564`; the five named topics are the target's own headings (L56, L90, L102, L125).
- "the `os lint` data-model rules and severities" — true: `packages/cli/src/commands/lint.ts` exists; the target lists the three severities and the data-model rule table.

Attempts to break it: a fragment that resolves on GitHub but not in the gate's slugger (none: all five are plain lowercase-and-hyphen slugs, and `check:skill-links` is green); a second reader of the stub lines (none in `skills/**`, `evals`, or any script pin); a section left with a doubled or missing separator (none).

**skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md — holds.**

| Cut (main) | Surviving home at this head | Verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| L273 §2.3 stub | L273 in-place entry → `examples-upgrade.md` L3 | holds |
| L413 §3.4 stub | L413 in-place entry → `examples-upgrade.md` L37 | holds |
| L457 v17 shapes stub | L457 in-place entry → `examples-upgrade.md` L86 | holds |
| one `---` line | none needed | holds |

The numbered sequence stays whole: 2.2, the 2.3 entry, 2.4; 3.3, the 3.4 entry, 3.5. The Quickstart's "template in §3.4" (L75) still lands on a line that begins "3.4" and links the template. Each entry's link text is the target heading word for word, so no entry claims more than its target holds. The two anchors that follow the entries (`decide-alone-or-ask`, `reverse-check`) are untouched.

Findings:

- **N1 · nit** — data SKILL.md L36–38: the index is headed "Detailed Rules" and introduced as "Detailed rules, with incorrect/correct examples", and four of its entries are now worked examples and reference tables. The existing Lifecycle Hooks entry already pointed into `references/`, so this widens a present looseness and misleads no one. Left as is, or reworded in a later prose pass.
- **N2 · nit** — upgrade SKILL.md L455–459: the v17 entry now sits after the `---` that closes §3 and directly above `## Failure modes` with no separator, so it reads as belonging to neither. The three upgrade entries also carry no description tail, unlike data's. Navigation is unaffected; the link text is the full heading.

No must-fix, no should-fix. Both nits are accepted deviations; neither needs a delta review.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-lc9hyi`
Reviewed-by: `session_01J8VVAmAzSRKZHAn7T8sArV`

**VERDICT: PASS**

- 为什么改:#31112 第 1 项的前置清理;指针行占 token 却不教内容,整包加载时是噪音。
- 风险与回滚:只改导航文字,规则内容不变;两个 token 行都缩小;回滚即 revert。

- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:skill-links` 绿(新锚点全部解析),PR 上 44 个 check 无红。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(`os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong`);契约复核 PASS 在案,评论 6768676093,`Head-sha: b11a73470838bb8ba5b72e68f27604ebf3eb774f`。

**席位意见:** ACCEPT。每条被删的行都有幸存归宿(复核 ④ 逐条核);两个 nit 记为接受的偏差。

## 席位核对

- **形态:** draft,目标 `main`,首行 `Part of #31112`(卡仍有余项,不自动关)。
- **前提实测:** 认领 6766041836 的前提成立;复核记录指出 data 实有 5 个桩(认领写 3),diff 全部处理。
- **门禁 check-runs:** 本 head 44 个全部结束,28 `success`、16 `skipped`、0 失败;dev 派生命令 46 条中 45 条 exit 0,`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` 本地需全包 `dist` 记 NOT MEASURED,CI 已绿(`/mnt/project-files/card-31112/s7-gates-b11a7347.txt`)。
- **接受的偏差:** "Detailed Rules" 标题现也索引示例与表格;upgrade 的 v17 条目位于 §3 与 Failure modes 之间。
- **范围外去向:** 无。`Metadata-protocol: none`。
- **落地条款:** Tier H(`check-governed-merges --pr 32187` 读 GOVERNED);已请 `os-zhuang`、`hotlong`;获批后席位落地;合并后 #31112 保持 open,摘标留待余项。

本记录取代 6768753248 的格式;结论不变。卡线程审核档豁免:维护者 2026-11-03 常设令。
